title: high-risk-safe
capability_statement: Declare risk_level high, and do nothing dangerous: one deterministic fixture prints one fixed string. The package exists so the §7.3 human-approval lane can be exercised end to end without running anything an operator would have to think about.

scope.problem_class: Exercising the high-risk adoption lane — typed refusal, human approval, sandbox attestation, terminal receipt — on a payload with no blast radius.
non_goals: Doing anything a high-risk package would normally do: this one writes no file, reads no secret and opens no socket
Standing in for a real high-risk package in a threat model
prerequisites: a POSIX shell on PATH — the fixture is one `echo`

steps.instruction: Run the fixture script and compare its stdout with the declared string. It takes no arguments, writes nothing and reads nothing outside its own text.

validation_gates.check: stdout of step 1 equals the declared string

rollback: Nothing was changed; there is nothing to roll back.

failure_modes.mitigation: install a POSIX shell, or run the package on a host that has one

evidence.summary: The fixture prints one fixed string; gate g1-stdout compares stdout with it. Nothing else is observed and nothing else is claimed.

safety.secrets_policy: No secrets are used, accepted or emitted by this package.
